## What changes?

Describe the problem and what this change does. Link a related issue if there is one.

## Verification

Describe the checks you ran and their results. Separate automated checks from physical-device tests; name the exact model, layout and operating system for hardware results. For documentation-only changes, checking links and wording is enough.

Add before/after screenshots for visible changes, using demo data.

## Before submitting

- [ ] No personal profiles, original-firmware backups, device identifiers, credentials or private logs are included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and translations are updated, or not affected.
- [ ] Model identification, backup and firmware-write safeguards remain intact, or are not affected.

See [Contributing](https://github.com/LatroX-dev/INGLORIOUS-Advanced/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for build and review guidance.
